Pull Request Overview


This pull request updates ROS2 documentation to use the correct command for launching rqt_graph. The change corrects command references from the deprecated rqt_graph to the proper ros2 run rqt_graph rqt_graph syntax.



Updates command syntax to use the standard ROS2 run interface


Ensures consistency across multiple tutorial files


Addresses issue #1717 regarding proper rqt_graph invocation
